title: Towards Hate Speech Detection at Large via Deep Generative Modeling
findings: The paper's proposed data augmentation technique, using a fine-tuned GPT-2 model, effectively generates realistic hate speech, including anti-Muslim content. This generated data significantly improves the performance (especially recall) of hate speech detection models, including for datasets that contain religiously-targeted hate speech (like the WS dataset).
